events.title: Server Start
events.description: The 25dollarphone Minecraft server went live for the first time.

events.title: Open to the Public
events.description: The server was opened to the public, allowing anyone to join and explore.

events.title: South Highway Expanded
events.description: The South Highway was expanded to accommodate growth.

events.title: Path Construction Begins
events.description: The community started building the main path network connecting all areas.

events.title: Building a Trusted Circle
events.description: A group of trusted players formed a circle to help maintain the server and assist new players.

events.title: Fighting Against Grief
events.description: Major grief incident hit the server. The community rallied together to fight back and protect builds.
